After every run, the launcher prints `emit_kv LAUNCHER_EXIT`, then `external_classify_launch_failure` lines (`LAUNCHER_FAILURE_CLASS` / `LAUNCHER_FAILURE_REASON`) to stdout for `ship-pr.sh`, using `${OUTPUT}.stderr` as the sidecar input. Missing `claude` on `PATH` emits `health`/`binary-missing` with `LAUNCHER_EXIT=127` before exiting **1**.

**Stdout-contract**: the script always exits 0 (except the early exit-1 when `claude` is absent from `PATH`). Callers **must** parse `LAUNCHER_EXIT=` from stdout to distinguish tool success from tool failure; the process exit code is not a reliable signal for the normal exit path.

The vendor name `claude` is **rejected** (returns 1 with a stderr warning) because it collides with the transcript-derived `claude` key in `token-report.sh`'s vendor-object merge and would overwrite main-agent totals. STALL_TRACKING=false
STALL_STEP=
BAIL_NEEDS_USER_INPUT=false
BAIL_REASON=
BAIL_FAILURE_DETAIL_LOG=
CI_PASSED=false
OOS_PENDING=false
PR_NUMBER=
PR_URL=
PR_TITLE=
RESUME_PHASE=
CALLER_KIND=
REBASE_COUNT=0
FIX_ATTEMPTS=0
ITERATION=0
TRANSIENT_RETRIES=0
FAILED_RUN_ID=
MANIFEST_PATH=
TOOL_LABEL=claude
DESIGN_ONLY_DONE=false
EXPECTED_SESSION_ID=$(cat "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-id" 2>/dev/null || true)
EXPECTED_TMPDIR_BASENAME_PREFIX=claude-implement-larch6-
NO_LOGS_COMMIT=false
IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR=$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR
CI_FIX_REBASE_PENDING=false
STATE
echo "ship-pr-state.sh written"

IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR=<TMPDIR>
export IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR
[ -z "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/plugin-root.env" ] && . "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/plugin-root.env"

. "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/bootstrap-routing.env"
LARCH_TOKEN_SESSION_ID=$("$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/read-session-env-key.sh" --file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh" --key LARCH_TOKEN_SESSION_ID --default "")
LARCH_CLAUDE_SOURCE_FILE=$("$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/read-session-env-key.sh" --file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh" --key LARCH_CLAUDE_SOURCE_FILE --default "")
LARCH_TIMING_LEDGER=$("$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/read-session-env-key.sh" --file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh" --key LARCH_TIMING_LEDGER --default "")
export LARCH_TOKEN_SESSION_ID LARCH_CLAUDE_SOURCE_FILE LARCH_TIMING_LEDGER

RUN_ID=$("$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/read-session-env-key.sh" --file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh" --key RUN_ID --default "")
ISSUE_NUMBER=$("$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/read-session-env-key.sh" --file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh" --key ISSUE_NUMBER --default "")
REPO=$("$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/read-session-env-key.sh" --file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh" --key REPO --default "")
REPO_UNAVAILABLE=$("$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/read-session-env-key.sh" --file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh" --key REPO_UNAVAILABLE --default "false")

# 8-pre-ship phantom probe
"$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/phantom-probe-with-warn.sh" --step 8-pre-ship

# Python 3.11+ guard
python3 -c 'import sys; raise SystemExit(0 if sys.version_info >= (3, 11) else 1)' || {
  echo '{"detail":"Python ship driver requires Python 3.11 or newer","failed_run_id":"","merge_result":"","needs_user_reason":"","outcome":"STALLED","pr_number":null,"pr_url":""}'
  exit 4
}

_clone_bt=$(basename "$PWD")
CLONE_TAG_FULL=$(printf '%s' "$_clone_bt" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9_-' '_')
CLONE_TAG_FULL=$(printf '%.32s' "$CLONE_TAG_FULL")
[ -n "$CLONE_TAG_FULL" ] || CLONE_TAG_FULL="_"

python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/python/ship.py" \
  --branch "$BRANCH_NAME" \
  --issue "$ISSUE_NUMBER" \
  --repo "$REPO" \
  --run-id "$RUN_ID" \
  --tmpdir "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR" \
  --manifest-path "" \
  --state-file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/ship-pr-state.sh" \
  --tool-label "claude" \
  --merge "true" \
  --draft "false" \
  --forked "false" \
  --repo-unavailable "$REPO_UNAVAILABLE" \
  --no-admin-fallback "false" \
  --no-logs-commit "false" \
  --expected-session-id "$(cat "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-id" 2>/dev/null || true)" \
  --expected-tmpdir-basename-prefix "claude-implement-${CLONE_TAG_FULL}-"
echo "SHIP_PY_RC=$?"

IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR=<TMPDIR>
cat "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/finalize-state.sh" 2>/dev/null | head -20 || echo "(no finalize-state)"
cat "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/ship-pr-state.sh" | head -20

IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR=<TMPDIR>
[ -z "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/plugin-root.env" ] && . "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/plugin-root.env"
"$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/read-session-env-key.sh" --file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh" --key ISSUE_NUMBER --default ""
"$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/read-session-env-key.sh" --file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh" --key RUN_ID --default ""

IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR=<TMPDIR>
command grep "ISSUE_NUMBER\|RUN_ID\|LARCH_ISSUE" "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh" | head -10

IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR=<TMPDIR>
head -30 "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh"

IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR=<TMPDIR>
cat "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/parent-issue.md"

IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR=<TMPDIR>
export IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR
[ -z "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/plugin-root.env" ] && . "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/plugin-root.env"

. "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/bootstrap-routing.env"
LARCH_TOKEN_SESSION_ID=$("$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/read-session-env-key.sh" --file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh" --key LARCH_TOKEN_SESSION_ID --default "")
LARCH_CLAUDE_SOURCE_FILE=$("$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/read-session-env-key.sh" --file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh" --key LARCH_CLAUDE_SOURCE_FILE --default "")
LARCH_TIMING_LEDGER=$("$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/read-session-env-key.sh" --file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh" --key LARCH_TIMING_LEDGER --default "")
export LARCH_TOKEN_SESSION_ID LARCH_CLAUDE_SOURCE_FILE LARCH_TIMING_LEDGER

# Read from parent-issue.md directly
ISSUE_NUMBER=$(awk -F= '/^ISSUE_NUMBER=/{print $2; exit}' "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/parent-issue.md")
RUN_ID=$(awk -F= '/^RUN_ID=/{print $2; exit}' "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/parent-issue.md")
REPO=$("$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/read-session-env-key.sh" --file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh" --key REPO --default "")
REPO_UNAVAILABLE=$("$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/read-session-env-key.sh" --file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh" --key REPO_UNAVAILABLE --default "false")

echo "ISSUE_NUMBER=$ISSUE_NUMBER"
echo "RUN_ID=$RUN_ID"
echo "REPO=$REPO"
echo "BRANCH_NAME=$BRANCH_NAME"

_clone_bt=$(basename "$PWD")
CLONE_TAG_FULL=$(printf '%s' "$_clone_bt" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9_-' '_')
CLONE_TAG_FULL=$(printf '%.32s' "$CLONE_TAG_FULL")
[ -n "$CLONE_TAG_FULL" ] || CLONE_TAG_FULL="_"

python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/python/ship.py" \
  --branch "$BRANCH_NAME" \
  --issue "$ISSUE_NUMBER" \
  --repo "$REPO" \
  --run-id "$RUN_ID" \
  --tmpdir "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR" \
  --manifest-path "" \
  --state-file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/ship-pr-state.sh" \
  --tool-label "claude" \
  --merge "true" \
  --draft "false" \
  --forked "false" \
  --repo-unavailable "$REPO_UNAVAILABLE" \
  --no-admin-fallback "false" \
  --no-logs-commit "false" \
  --expected-session-id "$(cat "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-id" 2>/dev/null || true)" \
  --expected-tmpdir-basename-prefix "claude-implement-${CLONE_TAG_FULL}-"
echo "SHIP_PY_RC=$?"
